title.narrative: Promotion of Youth Engagement in Local Governance Process (ProYEL)

description.narrative: Support the promotion of the involvement of youth in democratic and governance processes and the protection, promotion, and fulfillment of human rights. in specific : increasing youth participation and leadership in democratic life, facilitating youth participation in policy-making, planning, and monitoring; fostering young citizens collective voluntary engagement, learning exchanges; harnessing youth creativity and innovation.

comment.narrative: Under this workpackage In total 5 working palikas have celebrated annual palika day in three palikas of Karnali Province Dhungeshwor Simta and Gurnas. Likewise it was celebrated in two working palikas of Madhesh province Harion and Barahathawa. The palikas agreed to contribute their resources for organizing the event. The youth panel members organized marathon competition interschool quiz competion and quiz competition among others during the event. The midterm review reflected that local elected representatives have been positive about the initiation and have promised to celebrate the palika day even after the project. This celebration has influenced nearby palikas too the coapplicants have been requested by them to help organize the celebration. During the horizontal learning programme the knowhow to organize the annual palika will be shared with the interested palikas.

comment.narrative: In this reporting period one policy dialogue on GESI was conducted in Hariwon on October 2022. The session was facilitated by SSN Project Staff and the overall session was led by the Helvetas Nepal project GESI focal point where the data and scenario on GESI in Madhesh province were presented to Palika officials. The immediate result of the policy dialogue was a positive response from the Palika officials about developing the GESI policy and the Mayor of Hariwon expressed the commitment to endorse the GESI policy within the 3 months and seeking technical assistance
